abstract: A 37-year-old man with the chief complaints of lumbago and fever is presented. Laboratory data showed the extreme elevation of alfa feto-protein (AFP), human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) and lactate dehydorgenase (LDH). Computed tomography (CT) scan revealed a huge retroperitoneal tumor with multiple pulmonary nodules as well as left supraclavicular and left axillary lymph nodes enlargement. Although he was suspected the testicular tumor with metastasis, he had no testicular abnormalities including tumor and microlithiasis. Therefore, he was diagnosed as a retroperitoneal extra-gonadal germ cell tumor, which had poor prognosis because of multiple metastasis and the tremendous increase of hCG. Although he was treated with three cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin (BEP), he achieved partial response and no normalization of tumor markers. After three cycles of BEP, he was treated with four cycles of paclitaxel and ifosfamide plus cisplatin (TIP) immediately. During chemotherapy, he was treated with his peripheral blood stem cell transplantation (PBSCT) as well. After the completion of two regimens' chemotherapies, all his tumor markers returned to be normal. However, retroperitoneal tumor, left supraclavicular and axillary lymphnodes still remained. He underwent three operations including retroperitoneal lymphnode dissection with nephrectomy, left supraclavicular and axillary lymphnodes removal, respectively. All specimens had no viable cells, histologically, The patient has been quite well and free of disease for 24 months. It is concluded that even if far-advanced germ cell tumor is discovered, a more promising prognosis could be expected with intensive and aggressive treatment such as our case.
abstract_ja: 37歳男性が腰痛と発熱を主訴に来院した。検査では、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、LDHの著明な上昇を認めた。CTで、肺の多発結節および左鎖骨上窩・左腋窩リンパ節腫大を伴う巨大な後腹膜腫瘍を認めた。精巣転移を疑ったが、腫瘍や微小石灰化を含め精巣の異常は認めなかった。そのため、多発転移とhCGの著明な上昇から予後不良と考えられる後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と診断した。BEP×3コースを施行したが部分奏効にとどまり、腫瘍マーカーは正常化しなかった。続いてパクリタキセル・イホスファミド・シスプラチン併用(TIP)×4コースを直ちに施行し、化学療法中に末梢血幹細胞移植も併用した。2つのレジメンの化学療法終了後、すべての腫瘍マーカーは正常化した。しかし、後腹膜腫瘍と左鎖骨上窩・腋窩リンパ節は残存していた。3回の手術を受け、左腎摘除を伴う後腹膜リンパ節郭清、左鎖骨上窩・腋窩リンパ節切除をそれぞれ行った。病理組織学的には全標本で生存腫瘍細胞を認めなかった。患者は24か月間良好に経過し、無病である。進行した胚細胞腫瘍が発見された場合でも、本症例のような集中的で積極的な治療により、より良好な予後が期待できると結論された。
